initial_prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: final transparent PNG game HUD asset, landscape 1536 by 1024 canvas.
Primary request: Create ONE original, fictional rugged body-worn camera housing seen straight-on from a slightly elevated top angle. It should read as a compact matte black bodycam device with a horizontal display, suitable for a tiny in-game status overlay.
Composition: centered horizontally, entire isolated camera visible with alpha transparency around it. Body occupies approximately x=110..1426, y=225..800 on a 1536x1024 canvas. Wide low-profile shell with a soft asymmetric stepped shoulder at upper left, generously rounded outer corners and a continuous graphite rubber bumper. The main front face is close to flat with minimal perspective, easy to overlay a separate flat logo.
Original design: broad softly rounded rectangular shell, smooth matte central face, three short recessed horizontal grip slots at the far left, a wide dark smoked display LEFT OF CENTER, and a clean square recessed black badge panel on the RIGHT side of the face, around x=1055..1265, y=440..650. Put two small flush dark hex screws diagonally at upper-right and lower-left. Avoid faceted tapered endcaps, long parallel raised top/bottom rails, or a bottom-center badge.
Display: clear simple white recording camera glyph and the small white text "REC", separated horizontally, plus a small battery glyph. Use a different layout from real commercial cameras: one quiet horizontal row, no percentage number. Beside the screen near its upper-left include a small circular unlit dark red LED lens; it will be animated later in HTML.
Badge: LEAVE the right square panel completely BLANK and clean, no logo, no pattern, no text; a real CAD logo PNG will be positioned there separately.
Style: polished realistic 3D game asset, restrained fine polymer grain, subtle studio highlights to make the black contours legible, soft self-shadowing, crisp silhouette. No heavy noisy texture or excessive details.
Background: truly transparent alpha, no checkerboard painted in, no backdrop, no floor, no drop shadow outside the object.
Constraints: no manufacturer branding, no logos, no watermarks. Do not reproduce an Axon/TASER product silhouette, speaker-panel arrangement, central screen arrangement, logo placement, controls, or recognizable trade dress. Make the camera a distinctly original design while retaining a familiar rugged black camera feel.
final_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
This is a final game HUD housing asset. Edit the provided housing image with ONE small targeted change: remove the white "REC" text from the display, leaving that central part of the display black/smoked glass. Keep the white camera glyph on the left and battery glyph on the right exactly as they are. The overlay only indicates that the camera is enabled; no textual recording claim or battery percentage is wanted.
Preserve EVERYTHING else exactly: 1536 by 1024 canvas, camera position/scale/silhouette, original asymmetrical stepped upper shoulder, rounded rubber bumpers, three left grip slots, flush screws, red circular LED lens position, display edges, BLANK square logo plate at right, textures and highlights.
Preserve genuine background transparency/alpha. No background, floor or drop shadow beyond the housing, no logos, added text, patterns or redesign.
